articles.title: Yves Missi Suffers Leg Injury, Will Be Re-Evaluated Saturday
articles.summary: Yves Missi suffered a leg injury during the New Orleans Pelicans' 120-119 loss to the Utah Jazz on Friday night. Zion Williamson fell into Missi's leg with 6:30 left in the second quarter. Missi, who appeared unable to put any weight on the leg, was helped to the locker room. Missi will be re-evaluated on Saturday.
